verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly state incident.io offers 'public and private Status Pages' for customer communication, and status pages support automation/API/workflow publishing, implying some access control capability. However, no evidence details how access control works (e.g., audience-specific gating, SSO/SAML restriction, or separate employee-only vs customer-facing page configuration), so the specific 'engineering leader' control granularity is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: documentation of audience-based access rules, authentication/SSO gating for private pages, and multi-audience segmentation examples.
